title: Root normalization residue degrees divide the torsor group order
statement: Let i:U -> L and W -> U be a finite etale G-torsor, G finite. Let phi:Spec R -> L, f in R, and an isomorphism beta:U times_L Spec R = D(f) compatible with the maps to Spec R. Let H be a commutative Noetherian R-algebra via b, put g=b(f) and n=|G|, assume multiplication by g is injective, and H/(g) is a domain. Set A=H[t]/(t^n-g), N=Spec A and V=D(g). Assume prime localizations containing t are regular local and N is locally Noetherian. Pull the given torsor back to $V$, obtaining $p:P\to V$. Assume $p$ is finite etale. Set $a=p\circ V.\iota:P\to N$ and let $a^{\mathrm{norm}}:a.\mathrm{normalization}\to N$ be its concrete relative normalization; assume this map is finite. Let j:D -> N be a regular integral effective Cartier centre with image N minus V. At every normalization point x above j(eta), where eta is generic in D, the residue extension induced by the canonical residueFieldMap [def-weil-residue-field] is finite, and its vector-space degree [def-weil-vector-space-dimension] divides n=|G|. Formally its Module.finrank divides n; since n>0 this also forces finite dimensionality. No invertibility of n, separability of residues, or maximal-ideal equality is assumed or concluded.

theorem root_normalization_generic_stalk_residue_degree_dvd
    {L U : Scheme.{u}} (i : U ⟶ L)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (W : GaloisCover G U)
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : Spec R ⟶ L) (f : R)
    (β : pullback i φ ≅ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R)
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f))
    (hβ : β.hom ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R)
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) = pullback.snd i φ)
    (H : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsNoetherianRing H] (b : R ⟶ H)
    (hg : IsSMulRegular H (b.hom f))
    [IsDomain (H ⧸ Ideal.span {b.hom f})] :
    let g := b.hom f
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H A g)
    (∀ (Q : Ideal A) (hQ : Q.IsPrime),
      letI := hQ
      AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g) ∈ Q →
        IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime Q)) →
    ∀ (hN : IsLocallyNoetherian N),
    letI := hN
    let p := pullback.snd (W.π ≫ i) (V.ι ≫ q ≫ Spec.map b ≫ φ)
    ∀ (hp : IsFinite p),
    letI := hp
    let a := p ≫ V.ι
    Etale p → IsFinite a.fromNormalization →
    ∀ (D : Scheme.{u}) (j : D ⟶ N),
      IsRegular D → IsIntegral D → IsEffectiveCartierCenter j →
      (∀ z : N, z ∈ V ↔ z ∉ Set.range j) →
      ∀ (η : D), IsGenericPoint η Set.univ →
      ∀ (x : a.normalization), a.fromNormalization x = j η →
        letI := (a.fromNormalization.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
        Module.finrank (N.residueField (a.fromNormalization x))
          (a.normalization.residueField x) ∣ Nat.card G
